name: canvas-to-app
description: Build any design canvas into the real app in one pass without errors, keeping the codebase's architecture: read the whole canvas into a canvas-states.json manifest, map the codebase, a contract per screen, gate baseline, test-first build screen by screen, State gate per board state, independent review. Shares the canvas memory with spec-to-canvas. Up to 0.6.0 this name was the drawing plugin, now spec-to-canvas.
